summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PagBank), a foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The release discusses financial performance, including a 36% year-over-year expansion in credit portfolio and R$575 million non-GAAP net income, along with strategic priorities such as scaling credit and improving operating leverage. No extraordinary corporate events, transactions, or alternatives are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
